como_se_mide_en_vuelo.estacion: Bedtime and wake-up time in the check-in; actigraphy as a cross-check. Total duration only.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.transito: Bedtime and wake-up time in the check-in; actigraphy as a cross-check. Total duration only.
como_se_mide_en_vuelo.superficie: Bedtime and wake-up time in the check-in; actigraphy as a cross-check. Total duration only.

por_que: HRP risk: inadequate sleep and irregular schedules. Actigraphy estimates total duration well and efficiency and latency poorly, which is why it is never used alone.
referencia_en_vuelo: Average sleep in flight is 6 to 6.5 hours.
cuando_avisar: Personal deviation (layer B, 3.0 or more two days in a row) or downward drift (layer C, from day 21). With an amber status due to sleep, the vigilance test is offered.
prevencion: Consistent sleep schedule in crew quarters with little light and noise; blue-enriched light during the day and blue-depleted light before sleep.
fuentes: NASA HRP: Risks of Human Spaceflight
